provenance_policy: Strict Real-Data Separation (No synthetic data labeled as real benchmark data)

funsd.name: FUNSD (Form Understanding in Noisy Scanned Documents)
funsd.target_task: Real Scanned Document OCR (CER, WER, Failure Rate, Latency)
funsd.ground_truth_format: JSON with word-level bounding boxes and transcriptions

cord_v2.name: CORD v2 (Consolidated Receipt Dataset for Post-OCR Parsing)
cord_v2.ground_truth_format: Parquet / JSON line hierarchy with bounding boxes and field tags

nasa_ntrs.name: NASA Technical Reports Server (NTRS) Engineering Corpus
nasa_ntrs.target_task: Technical PDF Ingestion, Native Extraction vs OCR Routing, RAG Retrieval & QA
nasa_ntrs.license: Public Domain / Public Use Permitted (US Government Work)

csb_reports.name: U.S. Chemical Safety Board (CSB) Investigation Reports
csb_reports.target_task: Industrial Chemical & Petroleum Process RAG Retrieval, Citation Verification, Grounded QA
csb_reports.license: Public Domain (17 U.S.C. 105 - US Government Work)

pointer_meter.name: Pointer Meter Reader Benchmark Dataset
pointer_meter.target_task: Analog Dial Gauge & Meter Detection, Reading Estimation (MAE)
pointer_meter.ground_truth_format: YAML templates + values.json with calibrated scale endpoints and readings

docvqa.name: DocVQA (Document Visual Question Answering)
docvqa.target_task: Visual Question Answering on Document Images (Benchmark v2)

local_synthetic_fixtures.name: Local Synthetic Development Fixtures
local_synthetic_fixtures.target_task: Unit, Integration & Security Gate Testing ONLY (Strictly prohibited for real-data benchmark metrics)
local_synthetic_fixtures.source: Programmatic generation (PIL, FPDF, ReportLab) in repository
